s2.ptxt: Using a ball joint lock nut wrench (22mm), install the ventilation valve to the cylinder head cover.

torque.subtitle: When using ball joint lock nut wrench (22mm) + torque wrench L15.5cm

item.ptxt: The standard value when using ball joint lock nut wrench (22mm) + torque wrench L15.5cm is the value when ball joint lock nut wrench (22mm) and the torque wrench are used in a straight line.
When using a different torque wrench or a different angle, the standard value must be calculated. (For the procedure, refer to )
The effective length of ball joint lock nut wrench (22mm) is 15cm.

s2.ptxt: Slide the clamp and connect the ventilation hose.
Engage the 3 clips to install the V-bank cover.

item.ptxt: Make sure the clips are securely engaged.
Engaging them with excessive force or striking the top of the clips may cause damage.
